description: This file defines various custom exception classes used within the Orleans.Transactions namespace, representing different error conditions related to distributed transaction management in Orleans.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionException
classes.description: Base class for all transaction exceptions in Orleans.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionsDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates that transactions are disabled in Orleans.

classes.name: OrleansStartTransactionFailedException
classes.description: Indicates failure to start a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionOverloadException
classes.description: Indicates that the transaction runtime is overloaded.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionInDoubtException
classes.description: Indicates the transaction state is in doubt; unable to determine if committed.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionAbortedException
classes.description: Indicates that a transaction has been aborted.

classes.name: OrleansCascadingAbortException
classes.description: Indicates a transaction was aborted due to a dependent transaction aborting.

classes.name: OrleansOrphanCallException
classes.description: Indicates a transaction was aborted because a method didn't await all calls.

classes.name: OrleansReadOnlyViolatedException
classes.description: Indicates a read-only transaction attempted a write.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionServiceNotAvailableException
classes.description: Indicates the transaction service is unavailable.

classes.name: OrleansBrokenTransactionLockException
classes.description: Indicates a broken lock during transaction execution.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionLockUpgradeException
classes.description: Indicates failure to upgrade a lock during a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionPrepareTimeoutException
classes.description: Indicates a timeout during transaction prepare phase.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionTransientFailureException
classes.description: Indicates a transient failure during transaction execution.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Overrides method to serialize the exception data, includes TransactionId where applicable.
